summary: End-to-end test of new Candidates module + verification of Company logo fix and sidebar-sticky fix. Backend candidate CRUD (17 pytest cases including Auth, Candidates CRUD with GET-after-write persistence, master dropdown feeds) all pass against the preview URL. Frontend: Candidates sidebar nav visible, /admin/candidates list page renders with 4 stat cards + search + status filter + Add Candidate button. 4-step wizard renders preview card + stepper + progress bar. Step-1 gating (empty & invalid-email) shows inline errors and blocks advance; stepper is locked (disabled attr) for future steps until Personal is valid. Step-2 gating on Experience Level works. MultiSelect on Skills opens popover with cmdk items, adds removable chip on select. Step-3 → Step-4 works; ReactQuill editor + toolbar render, typing works. Status buttons + featured switch work. Submit POSTs to /api/candidates and navigates back to /admin/candidates where the new row appears with success toast. Back button + previously-completed-step click via stepper both work. COMPANY FIX: logo box sits on top of banner (overlaps=True, has z-10 wrapper, bannerBottom=262 vs logoTop=226 — logo overlaps the banner as intended). SIDEBAR FIX: left aside has position:sticky, top:0, height=100vh; after scrolling 2000px sidebar remains at viewportTop=0 with full height.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/.env has REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://backend.hiremejobs.co.in (a stale production backend that returns 404 for /api/candidates). At runtime in the preview deployment, requests actually resolve to https://hire-admin.preview.emergentagent.com/api/... (200 OK), so the app works — but if a production build is ever served from a domain that resolves the env value literally, /api/candidates would 404. Consider verifying/aligning REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL vs the production backend, or ensure the production backend deploy includes the new candidate routes.
CandidateForm.validateStep() is invoked inside the stepper render loop on every render (same pattern already noted for CompanyForm). Cheap here but couples render to validation.
STATUS_META in CandidatesList maps only 4 statuses; safe due to fallback to pending, but consider guarding against unknown values from backend.
In CandidatesList.toggleFeatured, on failure `setRows(rows)` restores the pre-toggle snapshot but the closure captures the pre-optimistic-update `rows`, which is correct — noting for readability.

Login button text is 'Sign In' (exact). Wizard testids: candidate-preview-card, candidate-stepper, cstep-personal|professional|education|status, cwizard-next-btn/back-btn/submit-btn, candidate-{name|email|phone|jobtitle|gender|dob|city|state|totalexp|explevel|cursalary|expsalary|notice|education}-{input|select}, candidate-{skills|languages}-multiselect, candidate-about-editor (click .ql-editor descendant to type), cstatus-active|inactive|pending|blocked, candidate-featured-switch, candidate-photo-upload, candidate-resume-upload, add-candidate-btn, candidates-refresh-btn. MultiSelect dropdown items expose [cmdk-item]. Some masters start empty in fresh DB; seed via POST /api/<master> before testing dropdown selections.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all requested features verified working. Only observation: frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to a stale prod backend; preview runtime still resolves to correct backend so no user-visible impact today.
